paragraphs.text: Methos was a human from Kenlefia in Jamuraa , who survived a journey to Vacar Slab .

The people of Kenlefia only mete justice on Vacar Slab , a place in the middle of the desert. Methos was deeply religious, following the Old Way, and he convinced his sister Ophelia to join him in escorting a prisoner they called the Abuser there, along with eight others. The journey was perilous, and the party members started dying sequentially. Two were ambushed by Aerathi berserkers and killed. A poisonous viper bit another, and their water-bearer Teeth fell off a cliff with most of their water. Then D'Bray , their flagbearer died of thirst, and Cleatin , their Gray Ogre protector was killed by a Duneclaw. Methos collapsed within a day of reaching their goal, dying of thirst before he could reach his goal.
